name: Bhagavad Gita 11.55
text:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः ।
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ॥
meaning: One who works for me, holds me supreme, is devoted to me, free of attachment and without enmity towards any being, comes to me.
purpose: Acting with dedication, devotion and freedom from hostility.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
